references.title: DWDS: inkognito
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Adverb; Herkunft aus gleichbedeutend ital. in cognito

notes.rationale: müssen wir diesmal inkognito bleiben, we must stay incognito. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root inkognito alone.
